root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces `mini_qdisc_pair_inited()` and changes `clsact_destroy()` to check this per-qdisc state instead of the global entry pointers. The CVE description states: "clsact_destroy() tests whether the {ingress,egress}_entry was non-NULL. However, even in midway failure on the replacement, both are in fact non-NULL with a valid egress_entry from the previous clsact instance."
